posts.subject: Ban apology to ViruszZ
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello ViruszZ,
I want to apologise for what happend today as yes I did calladmin abuse but there was someone breaking the rules and I wanted this to stop but there was no admin joining for like 2 maps so I dropped few calladmins every map and I was havining fun with the community and was having a laught when you joined I wanted to say " Hi ViruszZ" but this was a bad timing and you took it like I was baitining you to join the sever, I do agree I did change my name and I'm fully aware of this but I want to apologise so bad as I was not making any fun of you in anyway or baiting you to join the Knife server I was just generously following the rules and wanted other to, I hope you understand me and once again I'm really sorry as I did not want you to take it in a wrong was when I was laughing I just had fun with community and you joined and I guess took it as a bait, I want to show my best to the community and once more ViruszZ I want to say massive sorry from the bottom of my heart but I think you understand me.


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

Couldn't this have been sent in a message. In no insult to your effort of typing this out: this could have been sent to Virusz himself. Then to have the situation and implied apology more explained and thorough. Because for me: I am totally confused about the situation that caused the ban and the reason for the ban etc.

I said "yes I did change my name" and "no I did not bait ViruszZ to join the server in any way and did not meant it for fun"


//EDIT: And said I did report someone at least multiple times because no admin joined

#Doublepost sorry.


@OxygeN =D i talked with @ViruszZ about your ban, he said its okay and he will decrease the ban to 1 week, i hope its oke for you. If you are not okay with it, response to this thread again, or contact a higher admin about the issue.


Greetz ifZ4ne

I think week ban is bit harsh but it's up to @ViruszZ what he does.
@ifZ4ne thank you for speaking to him
